entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: internal invariant violated: a mixed float/histogram operand reached a histogram-vs-float-vector lowering
entries.rationale: expHistogramDroppingVectorBinop and expHistogramFloatVectorScalingBinop decline statically whenever isMixedRelationShape holds for either operand, and TestMixedRelationShapeAgreesWithEveryPolicyConsumer holds that predicate to the lowerings over every mixed-producing consumer the policy dispatch inventory names, so the float side of the two lowerings above lowers to a live mixed relation only for a producer that predicate does not name — an internal producer/predicate disagreement, not a query shape.
